description: Remove specific links from a record's relation field, leaving the relation and every other link intact. Fixes a mis-link (link_records with replace does too); unlike delete_relation, which drops the relation everywhere, it touches only the named links (#81).

relation_field.description: The relation field on this database (api_name, name, or id).

targets.description: Target record uuids or public numbers to unlink.

name: unlink_records
title: Unlink records
